name: TaleSpin
description: Baloo the Bear stars in an adventurous comedy of love and conflict with his friend Kit Cloudkicker. Rebecca Cunningham and her daughter Molly purchase Baloo's failing company and Baloo must fly transport runs to clear his debt while dodging Don Karnage and his sky pirates.

videos.title: Plunder & Lightning (Uncut)
videos.overview: This movie-length version of the origin story includes scenes not found in the episodic version, including a musical number featuring Rebecca singing to Molly (and indrectly to Kit).
